title: Alignment Tampering: How Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback Is Exploited to Optimize Misaligned Biases
reasoning: The paper investigates 'alignment tampering' which leads to the amplification of moral and social biases including sexism and propaganda (e.g., populism). It evaluates models based on these value-laden categories and discusses instrumental goal-seeking behaviors, which are central topics in AI ethics and safety.
